feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 25 November 2026 11:20am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 25 November 2026 at 11:20am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong Winds later.


##Synopsis##

High pressure over Scandinavia extends a ridge across the Irish Sea today.


##Wind##

East or southeast 4 or 5, but variable 3 or less in the far southwest of the area, increasing south or southeast 4 to 6 in all waters later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Rain in the west at first, becoming fair.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in the west at first.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southeast 5 or 6, increasing 6 or 7 occasionally gale 8 tomorrow evening, then veering west or northwest 2 to 4 Friday morning, but remaining southeast 5 or 6 in the east of the area.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, building moderate or rough for a time.


##Weather##

Rain spreads from the west tomorrow afternoon, becoming fair Friday morning.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.
